criteria.primary: Check2 primary is q mean in frozen open union; report all40 and q_prime separately, and any disagreement.
criteria.check2_yes: Mean bootstrap CI lower bound > permutation mean-S 95th percentile and upper-tail permutation p<=0.05.
criteria.check2_no: Entire mean bootstrap CI contained in central 95% permutation null band. Otherwise indeterminate; do not force A/B/C.
criteria.check3_yes: Non-transfer open-union paired distinct-label difference CI lower >0 AND point estimate new-label share>=0.20.
criteria.check3_no: Same difference CI includes0 AND point estimate new-label share<0.20. Otherwise indeterminate.
criteria.check1_no: For each direction pooled observed count lies within central95% null count interval AND upper-tail p>0.05. Apply D per direction; if both then whole bank. If observed below band or results mixed report separately without forcing table.
criteria.check1_yes: Observed directional pooled count exceeds null95th percentile AND upper-tail p<=0.05.
criteria.uncertainty: These conservative operational thresholds resolve otherwise unspecified cases before examining data. Report Luna/Sol decision disagreements, raw values, and unclassified outcomes.
